people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: Yahweh said to Moses, “They shall offer their offering, each prince on his day, for the dedication of the altar.”
translations.bsb: And the LORD said to Moses, “Each day one leader is to present his offering for the dedication of the altar.”
translations.kjv: And the LORD said unto Moses, They shall offer their offering, each prince on his day, for the dedicating of the altar.
translations.asv: And Jehovah said unto Moses, They shall offer their oblation, each prince on his day, for the dedication of the altar.
